RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

The panel's composition alone is not evidence of discrimination. While unconscious affinity bias or diversity objectives can occasionally influence decisions, leadership appointments heavily prioritize commercial acumen and interpersonal fit over pure technical tenure—areas explicitly emphasized in the successful candidate's client relationship record. 

Accusing the panel of bias based purely on their gender will appear unprofessional, damage your industry reputation, and close doors to future opportunities. Furthermore, a two-week delay for written feedback is standard corporate bureaucracy, not proof of foul play. Instead, send a polite follow-up focusing strictly on constructive feedback to understand how you can strengthen future leadership applications.
